entries.sense_en: a strong, restless wish for something

synonyms.nuance: Stronger and more physical; often for food or a drug.
Deeper and more emotional, often for something far away or lost.
A sudden push to do something, not a lingering wish.

entries.sense_en: the dull, overused quality of something ordinary

synonyms.nuance: Very close; slightly more formal, stresses lack of originality.
Suggests something once fresh that has gone flat through repetition.
Names a specific overused phrase or idea, not the general quality.

entries.sense_en: sank into a lower or lesser state; became quiet and ordinary

synonyms.nuance: Plain and physical; goes down, often into water or a chair.
Everyday phrase, used for feelings and people.
For noise, wind or excitement that fades gradually.

entries.sense_en: someone who brings something into being; a creator

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, modern; the person who started an idea.
Someone who sets up an organization or institution.
Figurative and warm; used with a field or movement.

entries.sense_en: first faint signs of something

synonyms.nuance: A small sign that suggests something without proving it.
A small beginning that may grow; more energetic.
A tiny amount left behind, not a beginning.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 a glimmer of hope처럼 쓰고, 복수형 glimmerings는 '여러 희미한 조짐'입니다.

entries.sense_en: fitted in and became part of a society

synonyms.nuance: Join a group while often keeping one's own identity.
Change oneself to suit new conditions; no group needed.
Informal; not stand out from those around you.

entries.sense_en: wild and untamed, like an animal in nature

synonyms.nuance: General word; never tamed or living in nature.
Stresses that no one has trained or controlled it.
Suggests fierce violence, often negative.

entries.tip_ko: feral은 원래 집에서 기르던 동물이 야생으로 돌아간 경우에 특히 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: the ordinary crowd; the common mass

synonyms.nuance: Any large group; no sense of being ordinary.
Stresses large number and lack of individuality.
Negative; people following others like animals.

entries.modern: "the ruck of human beings" → "the average run of people"
entries.tip_ko: 'the ruck'은 평범한 다수라는 뜻의 문어체 표현입니다.

entries.sense_en: to strip something of a quality or feeling

synonyms.nuance: Stronger and more physical; take off everything.
Used as "rid oneself of"; simpler and everyday.
Take something away, usually leaving a loss or harm.

entries.tip_ko: divest A of B는 'A에게서 B를 제거하다'입니다.

entries.sense_en: a twisted, strained movement of the face or lips

synonyms.nuance: A twisted face showing pain or disgust.
Plain and general; any bend or turn.
A change of shape from normal; not always human.

entries.sense_en: done slowly, one small part at a time

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; slow and steady change, planned or not.
Ordered stages, often deliberate and helpful.
Made of broken pieces; incomplete rather than gradual.

entries.tip_ko: 'piecemeal approach'는 체계 없이 조금씩 하는 방식이라는 다소 부정적인 뉘앙스가 있습니다.

entries.sense_en: slow and hesitant, with many stops

synonyms.nuance: Unsure and slow to act; describes people more than speech.
Weak or losing strength as it goes on.
Clumsy, with mistakes as well as pauses.

entries.sense_en: doubting that something is true

synonyms.nuance: Feeling unsure; milder and not necessarily a habit of mind.
Expects the worst of people's motives; harsher than sceptical.
Suspects a person or source of dishonesty.

entries.sense_en: clever and skilful, especially in a quick, smooth way

synonyms.nuance: General praise for ability at a task.
Quick and neat, mostly with the hands.
Clever in a sly, sometimes dishonest way.

entries.sense_en: the art of speaking without moving the lips so the voice seems to come from elsewhere

synonyms.nuance: Plain description of the same trick; less formal.
Broader: any deceiving trick, not about voice.
Something that seems real but is not.

entries.sense_en: opened wide, as eyes do with strong feeling

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for anything made broader.
Made bigger overall, not just open wider.
Grew in size or amount, often in all directions.

entries.sense_en: spoke slowly, stretching out the words in a lazy way

synonyms.nuance: Speak in a boring, flat, continuous voice.
Speak unclearly and quietly; not about speed.
Speak softly and low; gentle, not lazy.

entries.sense_en: unable or unwilling to believe something

synonyms.nuance: Doubts as a habit or after thinking; incredulous is a reaction of shock.
Refuses to accept it as true right now.
Mild; not persuaded by the argument.

entries.tip_ko: incredible(믿을 수 없는)과 혼동하지 마세요. incredulous는 '믿지 못하는 사람'을 말합니다.

entries.sense_en: amazingly large or impressive

synonyms.nuance: Very great in size or degree; very common.
Emphasizes huge physical or abstract size.
So big it shocks you.

entries.sense_en: a loud, confused noise of many voices

synonyms.nuance: Any loud, unpleasant noise, not only voices.
Noisy anger or excitement, often about something.
Informal; an annoying loud noise.

entries.sense_en: a stiff, uneasy feeling that stops people speaking freely

synonyms.nuance: Self-control or holding back, often on purpose.
Social discomfort; everyday word.
A rule or condition that restricts; not a feeling.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 '제약'이라는 뜻이지만, 여기서는 감정이 억눌린 어색함을 말합니다.

entries.sense_en: expressed in a particular style of words or tone

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; put into words.
Focuses on the choice of words.
Like phrased; usually for written text.

entries.tip_ko: be couched in ...(~한 어조로 표현되다) 형태로 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: a quick, sharp or witty reply

synonyms.nuance: An angry or sharp reply, often to an insult.
Informal; a clever answer to criticism.
Elegant and witty counter-reply; literary.

entries.sense_en: in a very cold, unfriendly manner

synonyms.nuance: Common; without warmth.
Stronger; sharp, freezing politeness with anger under it.
Formal and awkward rather than hostile.

entries.sense_en: jumped into the conversation suddenly and without care

synonyms.nuance: Start something eagerly; more positive.
Interrupt rudely.
Join quickly; neutral.

entries.sense_en: wild or improper behavior, especially in love affairs

synonyms.nuance: Very close; strange or suspicious activities.
Silly, funny behavior; not scandalous.
Daring, exciting adventures, often reckless.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 carrying-on 또는 carryings-on 형태로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: making you feel uneasy and unsure

synonyms.nuance: Disturbs your calm; slightly stronger.
Makes you feel shame in front of others.
Suggests real danger or worry.

entries.sense_en: a low wall or rail with small posts along a balcony

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a fence-like barrier of bars.
The rail beside stairs.
A low solid wall at a roof or bridge edge.

entries.sense_en: a place for a relaxed walk

synonyms.nuance: A plain path for walking; no leisure feel.
The act of a relaxed walk, not the place.
A wide open path beside the sea.

entries.sense_en: talking about past memories

synonyms.nuance: Remembering with warm, sentimental feeling.
Bringing memories or feelings to mind; describes things.
Looking back, often formally or analytically.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 reminiscent of ~(~을 떠올리게 하는)로 쓰지만, 여기서는 '회상에 잠기는'의 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: uncomfortable and nervous

synonyms.nuance: Slightly worried; the everyday word.
Socially clumsy or embarrassed.
Tense and nervous, ready to react.

entries.sense_en: morally very bad (used here as a joke)

synonyms.nuance: Dishonest or morally rotten, often by power or money.
Deliberately evil; can be playful.
Against accepted moral rules; general and milder.

entries.sense_en: the ability to stay calm and think quickly in a crisis

synonyms.nuance: Calm control of feelings; not about quick thinking.
Fast, clever reaction to a situation.
A steady, sensible nature over time.

entries.sense_en: a payment to keep someone from telling a secret

synonyms.nuance: Money to make someone do something wrong, not only stay silent.
The crime of demanding money by threatening to reveal a secret; hush money is the payment itself.
Informal; a secret payment to settle a problem.

entries.sense_en: was only looking to get

synonyms.nuance: Informal; wanting something.
Doing something only for a personal gain.
More formal; look for.

entries.sense_en: embarrassed and thrown off balance

synonyms.nuance: Ashamed or self-conscious; the everyday word.
Confused and nervous, unable to act calmly.
Unsettled by something unexpected.

entries.sense_en: killed or gotten rid of

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; remove anything unwanted.
Formal; end a law or system.
Euphemism for killing a sick or dangerous animal.
synonyms.example: the dog had to be put down

entries.sense_en: attacked or troubled from all sides

synonyms.nuance: Trouble again and again over time.
Surround with demands or attackers.
Bother repeatedly and aggressively.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 beset by/with ~ 형태로, 수동태로 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: angry criticism for something done wrong

synonyms.nuance: Everyday, as when talking to a child.
Disappointed criticism, less loud.
Official, formal criticism from an authority.

entries.sense_en: argued in protest, trying to change someone's mind

synonyms.nuance: General word for objecting.
Say you disagree; milder.
Formal; argue in order to change conduct.

entries.sense_en: sad and disappointed after a failure

synonyms.nuance: Low-spirited; longer lasting.
Lost hope or confidence after a setback.
Looking sad, often with eyes lowered.

entries.sense_en: a skin disease of animals that makes fur fall out

synonyms.nuance: The similar itching disease of humans.
General red skin patches, any cause.
Any illness; not specific.

entries.sense_en: in a way meant to be noticed

synonyms.nuance: Bright and attention-seeking, often about clothes.
Done so that others see a message.
Colorful and confident; can be admired.

entries.sense_en: gloomy and silent like a tomb

synonyms.nuance: Common word for dark or sad.
Slow and solemn like a funeral.
Unhealthily interested in death.

entries.sense_en: a long period of staying awake to wait or watch

synonyms.nuance: General; keeping guard or looking out.
Staying up with a dead person before burial.
Police watching a place secretly.

entries.sense_en: sad and gloomy in an exaggerated way

synonyms.nuance: Sad because of loss; sincere.
Sad and gloomy in look or sound.
Overacted feeling; close to lugubrious here.

entries.sense_en: without anyone saying it, by silent agreement

synonyms.nuance: Just without noise; no idea of agreement.
Understood without being stated.
Rare; unsaid.

entries.sense_en: stopped something before it could happen

synonyms.nuance: General; stop something from happening.
Act first to take away another's chance.
Informal; stop a problem early.

entries.sense_en: arrive or appear

synonyms.nuance: Informal; arrive, often unexpectedly or late.
Neutral, more formal.
Become visible; less about traveling.
